cards.card_text: Shishak brings 1,200 chariots, 60,000 horsemen and countless troops out of Egypt: Libyans, Sukkites and Cushites.
cards.verse_text: with 1,200 chariots, 60,000 horsemen, and countless troops who came with him out of Egypt—Libyans, Sukkites, and Cushites.
cards.snippet: …chariots, 60,000 horsemen, and countless troops who came with him out of Egypt—Libyans, Sukkites, and Cushites.

cards.card_text: He'll gain control of Egypt's gold, silver and riches, and the Libyans and Cushites will submit to him too.
cards.verse_text: He will gain control of the treasures of gold and silver and over all the riches of Egypt, and the Libyans and Cushites will also submit to him.
cards.snippet: …gold and silver and over all the riches of Egypt, and the Libyans and Cushites will also submit to him.
